reviewer: root agent; independent of model author
comparisons: Compared official 2022 site plan and dong/floor diagram plus July2023 completed photographs with southeast, northwest, plan and crown renders. Four distinct six-wing plans, orientations, white window piers, green glazing, refuge bands and projecting crown caps are represented.

Checked A64/B65/C63/D65 floor differences and thin refuge bands; rejected the first overly wide canopy/bright facade pass before this version. OSM-centred plan traces are approximations, with 1.49–4.03m control residuals and 0.60–0.66 source-plan IoU.

Business tower and low site structures are explicitly excluded from replacement ownership. Exact crown geometry, mullion spacing and total heights are photograph/source-based estimates, not measured as-built reproduction.
limits: Reference reconstruction for the city map; no claim of survey precision or exact current facade materials.
